name: Ichimaru
source:
Likes: Udon
Hobby: Reading

An 'Ayakashi-tsuki' who has mystic powers.
A few years ago he took over the family 'business' "Yorozu Ayakashi-ya" from the protagonist's grandfather.
He's very prideful and hates to lose.
He doesn't mingle with people much and is usually alone.
